title: Adapter client profile
description: Every client choice of an adapter delivery. A profile file may set any subset of these fields; `extends` names a parent profile whose values it overrides (objects merge key by key, lists and scalars replace). Defaults below apply where neither file sets a value. Unknown fields are errors. Patterns use {placeholders}; regular expressions are Python syntax and are data, never code.

idPattern.description: Text with {placeholders}: {chapter} chapter number, {part} part number, {level} section depth inside the chapter, {n} running number of this kind inside the chapter (or the printed number's last component for numbered objects), {num} the printed number.

regex.description: A Python regular expression (data). Named groups are documented on each field.

role.description: A `role` attribute value, or null for no role.

inlineMap.description: How one inline span kind is written.

element.description: Output element, or null to write the text without markup.

frontSection.description: How one kind of front-matter or back-matter section (from book.json navigation.sections) is delivered.

element.description: omit: not delivered (its text is listed as omitted by profile in the lossless report); bookinfo: represented by book settings in <bookinfo>; continue_previous: the pages belong to the preceding division (for example chapter references detected as a rear section).

page_anchors.description: keep: the pages still get page anchors (placed at the nearest allowed position); drop: no anchors for these pages.

default_title.description: Title written when the source has none (generated text, listed in the report).

split_on_titles.description: Start a new element at each front-section title (several prefaces in one source section).

name.description: Kind name (figure, flowchart, chart...). Each kind numbers separately.

caption_label.description: Matches the printed label at the start of a caption; groups `word` and `num`. The matched text moves to the label attribute.

label.description: Label attribute text; {num} is the printed number, {word} the printed word.

rule.description: Named rule switched on when the option is true.

date.description: Date of the guideline or profile revision (YYYY-MM-DD).

extends.description: Parent profile path relative to the profiles folder, without .yaml (for example _base/docbook_base).

description.description: One paragraph: client, format, guideline source.

guideline.description: Guideline document and version this profile encodes.

confirm_with_client.description: Settings chosen without the client's word (guesses from a delivery, owner decisions). The QC report lists each with its current value until the client confirms it.

epub.description: ePub 3 output (writer `epub3`). Optional: a profile without this section only makes DocBook. Fields here are read only when the ePub is made.

package.description: Folder and file names inside the ePub.

content_folder.description: Folder inside the ePub holding every content file.

text_folder.description: Folder (inside the content folder) for the XHTML files; empty for none.

image_folder.description: Folder (inside the content folder) for the images.

style_folder.description: Folder (inside the content folder) for the CSS files.

package_file.description: Package document name (inside the content folder).

nav_file.description: ePub 3 navigation document: contents, page list, landmarks.

toc_file.description: Contents page in the reading order; its <nav> has the container id from nav.toc_container_id. Empty for none.

chapter_file.description: File name of a chapter or part; {id} is its id (ch3, prt2).

front_file.description: File name of a front or back matter division; {kind} (preface, dedication, appendix...) and {n} its number among that kind.

copyright_file.description: Copyright page (the legal notice and ISBN).

css.description: Style sheets written to the style folder and linked from every XHTML file, in this order. `source` is a file in profiles/css/; `text` is the CSS itself (for a profile uploaded without a css folder). The placeholder @LINK_COLOUR@ in the CSS is replaced by link_colour.

link_colour.description: Colour of links in the text, matching the PDF (a CSS colour, or `inherit` for the text colour). Never the reader's default blue (guideline EPUB item 2).

cover.description: Front cover rule. The image comes from the book settings (epub.cover_image) or, if the cover page of the PDF holds a picture, from that; with neither, no cover page is written and a must-check review item asks for the image.

mode.description: front_only: the front cover alone (guideline EPUB item 1); no inside-cover or back-cover page is ever written. none: no cover page.

image_name.description: Cover image file name in the image folder.

alt.description: Alt text of the cover image.

label.description: Landmark and contents label of the cover.

enabled.description: Write a half title page (the book title alone) before the title page.

heading.description: Heading and landmark label of the half title page (guideline EPUB item 3: not 'Halftitle').

heading_visible.description: Show the heading on the page; false keeps it for readers and navigation only.

label.description: Landmark and contents label of the title page.
Landmark label of the copyright page.

enabled.description: Write the legacy <guide> in the package document (guideline EPUB item 4) as well as the ePub 3 landmarks in the navigation document.

toc_depth.description: Deepest heading level listed in the contents (1 = divisions).

toc_container_id.description: id of the contents container that headings link back to (guideline EPUB item 5).

toc_return.description: Every heading listed in the contents links back to the contents: to its own entry, to the container id, or not at all (item 5 requires a link).

page_list.description: Write a page list from the page anchors.

landmarks.description: Write ePub 3 landmarks in the navigation document.
Landmarks in this order: an ePub 3 epub:type, and the label shown. An entry whose page does not exist in the book is left out. The package <guide> uses the same list.

metadata.description: Package metadata not taken from the book.

publisher.description: Publisher (dc:publisher). Book settings `publisher` overrides it; empty omits the element.

language.description: Language of the book when neither the converter nor the settings give one.

enabled.description: Write the schema.org accessibility metadata (accessMode, accessModeSufficient, accessibilityFeature, accessibilityHazard, accessibilitySummary) from what the book really contains.

hazard.description: accessibilityHazard. A book of text and still images has no flashing, motion or sound: none. Use unknown if the publisher has not checked.

conforms_to.description: dcterms:conformsTo value (for example a WCAG conformance URL). Empty omits it: nothing is claimed that no one has audited.

images.description: Images in the ePub (naming follows images.name / images.front_name).

format.description: Image file format in the ePub.

max_width.description: Widest image in pixels (null: source size).

mathml.description: Write an equation that has MathML as MathML (with alttext); otherwise its image.

name.description: DTD used for validation (pinned copy shipped with the adapters).

delivery.description: Folder and file layout of the delivery.

main_doctype.description: DOCTYPE line of the main file: written, written inside a comment, or absent.

main_declaration.description: Write <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?> in the main file.

split_files.description: Also write one file per chapter, front matter and index.

part_files.description: With split files: a chapter that opens a part carries the part title and intro, closed after that chapter (one well-formed file).

split_declaration.description: Write the XML declaration in split files.

chapters_folder.description: Folder holding split files and images.

chapter_file.description: Chapter file name; {chapter_id} is the chapter id.

front_file.description: Front matter file (root <book> with bookinfo and front elements), or null.

file.description: page_info file name at the delivery root, or null for none.

images_folder.description: Folder (inside the delivery root) for images.

bigimages_folder.description: Folder for full-size copies of numbered figure images, or null.

zip.description: Also pack the delivery folder into this ZIP next to it ({isbn}); deterministic (fixed timestamps, sorted entries). null: no ZIP.

missing_isbn_folder.description: Folder/file stem used while the ISBN is not supplied (the report warns).

name.description: File stem for body images; {page_label} printed page label, {page} physical page, {n} sequence on that page in reading order (from 1).

front_name.description: File stem for front-matter images; {n} runs through the whole front matter.

max_width.description: Images folder: scale down to this width in pixels (null keeps source size).

dpi.description: DPI written in the image file.

big_max_width.description: Big images: the same image at source size, scaled down only above this width (null: no cap).

big_include.description: Which images go to the big images folder.

equation_images.description: Write equation image fallbacks as files.

section_title_role.description: Role of section titles (pattern like section), or null.

continued_figure.description: ID of a continued figure; {k} counts continuations.

outside_chapter.description: Value of {chapter} for objects outside any chapter (front matter, parts, appendices).

section_numbering.description: per_level_in_chapter: {n} counts sections of each depth through the whole chapter.

part.description: {n} part number; {word} the printed label word when found (else the pattern text is used as is).

sidebar.description: Box label. DocBook 4.2 declares no label on sidebar, so a DocBook delivery leaves this null (the box id and title role are still written).

continued_figure.description: Label of a continued figure (item: continued numbered figures).

outline.description: How parts and chapters are found. Stage 1 headings come first; the fallbacks are evidence from printed labels and the printed table of contents.

part_roles.description: Heading roles that open a part.

chapter_roles.description: Heading roles that open a chapter.

part_label_words.description: Printed words (compared letters only, case-insensitive; spaced letters allowed) that mark a part opener in figure text or a label paragraph.

chapter_label_words.description: Printed words that mark a chapter opener.

use_opener_text.description: Use text inside opener artwork (banner figures) as part/chapter label and title.

use_toc_targets.description: When a printed TOC entry targets a page with no chapter start, start a chapter there (title from the TOC entry or the opener).

toc_entry_number.description: Parses a TOC chapter entry: groups num, title (leader dots and page number excluded).

drop_opener_artwork.description: Opener banner artwork whose text became the label/title is not delivered as an image.

body_before_first_chapter.description: Body content before the first chapter start.

part_intro_wrapper.description: Wrap the content of a part intro (partintro) in one sidebar.

front_matter.description: Delivery of each navigation section kind outside chapters.

sections.description: Map: section kind (cover, title_page, copyright, dedication, table_of_contents, preface, front_other, index, bibliography, glossary, appendix, rear_other) -> delivery.

page_anchor_front.description: Front-matter anchor id; {number} is the roman label as a number (or the physical page).

isbn_after_legalnotice.description: Write <isbn> after the first legal notice.

title_page_artwork.description: Images on the title page (publisher logo): first in the legal notice, or not delivered.

roles.description: Map: book.json paragraph role (body, display_title, label, credit, figure_text, table_text, heading_candidate, list_item_candidate, caption, footnote) -> para role.

first_after_title_role.description: Role of a running-text paragraph that directly follows a chapter, section or preface title (null: as roles).

following_role.description: Role of later running-text paragraphs in chapters, sections and prefaces (null: as roles).

running_text_kinds.description: Paragraph kinds the two roles above apply to.

join_continuations.description: Join paragraph and item pieces across page/column breaks into one element (page anchor inside).

subchapter_role.description: Role for subchapter titles coded as para.

map.description: Map: span kind (bold, italic, bold_italic, superscript, subscript, small_caps, underline, link) -> output.

in_titles.description: Span kinds written inside section/part/chapter titles (others are dropped there; the text stays).

in_object_titles.description: Span kinds written inside figure/table/sidebar titles.

small_caps.description: Small caps only where the PDF uses them.

bold_italic.description: Text both bold and italic: one element with the bold_italic mapping, or bold and italic elements nested.

id.description: Body page anchor id; {label} printed page label, {page} physical page.

unlabelled_id.description: Id for a page without a printed label.

titles.description: Titles that may hold an anchor.

first_last_roles.description: role="first"/"last" on the first and last page anchors of each part and chapter.

standalone.description: Where an anchor goes when no text follows in its division: a new <para>, or the end of the previous para.

kinds.description: Numbered figure kinds, tried in order on the caption.

titled_unnumbered.description: A figure with a caption but no number.

decorative.description: Decorative artwork the converter marks (title banners, opener art, ornament bands).

imagedata_align.description: align attribute of imagedata in figures (null: none).

alt_text_placeholder.description: Text written in textobject/phrase when no alt text exists (each one is a review entry). An export with any placeholder left fails unless the user passes an explicit override, which the report records.

embedded_text.description: Text inside a figure: omit (it stays in the image; the alt text describes it; it remains in book.json and is listed as omitted by profile), a second textobject (role figuretext), or a caption para.

credits.description: Figure credits/notes: mediaobject caption, or a para after the figure.

attach_following_captions.description: An unlinked caption unit that starts with a figure label and directly follows a figure becomes its caption (declared move).

title_label.description: Label at the start of a table title; groups word, num.

empty_entry.description: Empty cells are self-closed entries (no dummy para).

notes.description: Table notes: a last row spanning all columns, or paras after the table.

join_continued.description: Join a table continued on the next page into one table; repeated header rows are dropped (listed as omitted).

marks.description: Map: printed bullet glyph -> mark attribute value.

default_mark.description: Mark for an unknown glyph (each one is a review entry).

unmarked_mark.description: Mark for unmarked lists (null: no mark attribute).

join_segments.description: Join list segments of the same list across page breaks.

title_label.description: Label at the start of a box title; numbered boxes get id and label.

callouts.description: Coloured callout boxes and cards are written as sidebars.

table_only.description: A box whose only content is one table: sidebar (the box is kept around the table) or table (the table alone; the box colour is styling).

title_patterns.description: A heading or title paragraph matching one of these opens a chapter bibliography.

suggested_reading_patterns.description: Titles handled by the suggested-reading rule when it is on.

marker_from_text.description: Leading entry number in the text when the entry has no structural marker.

marker_element.description: Entry number element, or null to leave it in the text.

link.description: ulink url of a page locator; {anchor} is the target page anchor id.

suffix_in_link.description: Locator suffixes (figure, table...) kept inside the link.

divs.description: indexdiv grouping; from_dividers falls back to by_first_letter (generated letter titles) when the index has no printed dividers.

range_links.description: A page range locator (43–46): one link over the whole range to its first page, or each end linked to its own page with the dash between the links.

infer_locators.description: Where book.json gives an index entry no locator, read page numbers at the end of its lines (after a two-space gap or a comma, resolved through printed page labels) and split an item whose lines each end in page numbers and start a new term. Each inference is an adapter-inferred review entry.

authors.description: Author names and affiliations read from the title page for <bookinfo> when the book settings give no author groups. Lines are classified by these word lists and patterns only (no fonts or positions). Every person read is a review entry; an unclear split is must_check.

from_title_page.description: Read authors from the title page when the book settings have no authorgroups.

group.description: per_author: one <authorgroup> per person, the role label (contrib) on the first person of each role; per_role: one <authorgroup> per role label.

role_labels.description: A whole line matching one of these is a role label (Editors, Foreword...), written as <contrib>.

stop_lines.description: A line matching one of these ends the author block (publisher name, imprint).

degree_token.description: A word that is a degree (MD, PhD, F-RSSDI, MD(Medicine)); degrees at the end of a name line, and lines that start with one, are <othername role="degrees">.

known_degrees.description: Degrees the client's books use; a degree-like word not listed makes the split must_check ("PT" may be initials).

job_words.description: Words of job titles (Professor, Director...): such a line is a <jobtitle>, never a name.

org_words.description: Words of organisation names (College, Hospital, LLP...): the first such line is <orgname>.

orgdiv_words.description: Words of departments (Department, Division...): such a line is <orgdiv>.

links.description: Web and e-mail addresses printed in the text (rule link_urls_emails).

www_scheme.description: Scheme put before an address printed as www.… in the link url.

mode.description: Footnotes are paras at their place (the marker link is not decided by Stage 1).

escape.description: Map: character -> written form in text.

forbidden_named_entities.description: Named entities that must not appear (house check).

set_title_patterns.description: Titles that open a question set (one qandadiv each).

note_pattern.description: Text removed by the colour-plate rule (listed as omitted).

rules.description: Named rules switched on (each is a function in book_adapters.rules).

book_options.description: Per-book options the profile asks for in the book settings (name -> declaration).
